subject: Post-call: OrchardAI evaluation — pain recap & proposed MPA
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Dana Park <dana.park@orchardai.com>, OrchardAI Procurement <procurement@orchardai.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: OrchardAI evaluation — pain recap & proposed MPA

Hi Dana — thanks for taking the time today. Quick written recap so we have a shared baseline and a proposed Mutual Action Plan (MPA) to get to pilot decisions. Please flag anything we missed or items you'd like moved earlier/later.

Key pain points you called out
- Production latency spikes for API calls during peak hourly batches (p95 often >700ms).
- Token/embedding unit costs are higher than expected for your current workload patterns.
- Security/compliance: SOC 2 evidence, KMS integration, and data residency for EU customers.
- Need for predictable throughput for batch enrichment jobs (50k reqs/day target).

Goals we heard
- Run a 6-week pilot that models your production traffic (50k reqs/day), aim p50 <200ms and p95 <350ms.
- Validate cost profile with quantized model variant and batching strategies to hit your target cost per 1k requests.
- Prove SOC 2 artifact retrieval and KMS integration in a private VPC setup.

Proposed MPA (high level) — milestones, owners, target dates
1) Pilot scope & success criteria — Owner: Dana / Product — target: 2026-12-03
2) Environment & security onboarding (VPC + KMS test keys) — Owner: OrchardAI Sec / Redwood Security (Rishi) — target: 2026-12-10
3) Pilot run (traffic ramp & observability) — Owner: OrchardAI Eng / Redwood SRE (Marcus) — window: 2026-12-11 to 2027-01-22
4) Cost/quality review & executive decision — Owner: OrchardAI Execs / Redwood AE (Irene) — review by 2027-01-29

Attachments: OrchardAI-MPA-draft.xlsx (MPA template), SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf (what we can share immediately).

Next steps I propose from Redwood:
- We update the MPA with the specific stakeholder names you confirm below.
- Rishi will share the SOC 2 artifact checklist and onboarding steps for KMS.
- Marcus will run a short pre-pilot load test the week of 12/7 to validate baseline latency expectations.

Can you confirm the three items above and the target dates, or suggest changes? If the dates look reasonable we'll lock them and circulate calendar invites.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0143

- Pilot size: 50k reqs/day is the right target; we want to include both synchronous embedding calls and async batch enrichment jobs.
- Security: SOC 2 is critical — we have an internal security reviewer (Liam Chen, CTO) and a procurement owner (Maya Rao) who will need to be in the loop.

Stakeholders to add into the MPA
- Liam Chen <liam.chen@orchardai.com> (CTO) — security & technical sign-off
- Maya Rao <maya.rao@orchardai.com> (Procurement) — contracts and commercial sign-off
- Ellie Park <ellie.park@orchardai.com> (Engineering Manager) — pilot day-to-day owner

On dates: the security onboarding by 12/10 is aggressive but doable if we get the KMS test keys and a short artifact packet by EOD Monday 11/30. Procurement will aim to review initial commercial terms by 12/20; legal needs a week after that for redlines.

I'll attach a short internal roles doc — will share a version with names.

Thanks — Dana
